name: Dogs Trust
summary: The UK's largest dog welfare charity: 20 rehoming centres and a foster network that rehomed about 10,000 dogs in 2025, behaviour support for owners, foster care for dogs of people escaping domestic abuse, campaigns such as the 2025 law against puppy smuggling, and overseas work through its sister charity Worldwide Veterinary Service (rabies vaccination, treatment and neutering) and Dogs Trust Ireland and Bosnia.

spending.source: https://docs.dogstrust.org.uk/Annual-Report-2025.pdf (Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial activities p. 94 and note 7 p. 103: charitable activities £116.941m of total expenditure £162.805m, year to 31 December 2025; excludes raising funds £45.864m. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS).)

lines.label: Rehoming, prevention, campaigns and overseas dog care (all but rabies control)
lines.source: https://docs.dogstrust.org.uk/Annual-Report-2025.pdf (Annual Report 2025, p. 94): rehoming £64.407m, prevention services £19.975m, brand £6.460m and 75% of international work (£26.099m less the rabies share, facts/dogs_trust.json rabies_share_of_international, our judgment of 25%), year to 31 December 2025. One line because charityevals models these activities as branches of one companion-animals model. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS). £110.416m = $145,473,409.

lines.label: Rabies control overseas (WVS and Mission Rabies, grants to rabies programmes)
lines.source: https://docs.dogstrust.org.uk/Annual-Report-2025.pdf (Annual Report 2025, p. 94): 25% of international work £26.099m (facts/dogs_trust.json rabies_share_of_international, our judgment; the accounts don't split international work by activity), year to 31 December 2025. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS). £6.525m = $8,596,358.
